preconditions.description: The input string must have a length between 1 and 30 (inclusive).
The integer k must be between 1 and 10 (inclusive).
The input string must consist only of digits.

postconditions.description: The output string must have the same length as the input string.
The output string must consist only of digits.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join(sorted(str, reverse=True)) or (k == 0 and return_value == str)
postconditions.description: If k is 0, the output must be the input string unchanged. Otherwise, the output must be the largest possible number formed by performing at most k swaps on the input string's digits.
